existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system with login and signup functionality using Internet Identity
Create a search bar component that allows users to search for books
Build a book catalog section that displays books with their images and prices
Design the website with a light color scheme and leafy design theme, creating a natural, warm aesthetic with botanical elements and soft tones
Implement standard website features including navigation, footer, and responsive layout
Update the website name from 'Book Haven' to 'Kitabi Keeda' in all frontend components including Navigation header, Footer, HTML title, and any branding elements
Change the website background color to Pistachio Mist throughout the application, updating the color palette in Tailwind configuration and CSS variables
Enhance the leafy design theme with additional botanical elements and decorative leaf patterns across the website layout, including headers, sections, and backgrounds
Increase the visual prominence of the login/signup button by making its background color deeper and more contrasting against the Pistachio Mist theme to ensure it is clearly visible in the navigation
Create a book preferences section positioned below the search bar where users can select their preferred book genres through a multi-select or filter interface
Display 5-6 sample books on the front page with placeholder images (labeled 'Image to be uploaded' or showing blank placeholders) and prices ranging from ₹100 to ₹200
Add a 'Sell Your Book' feature accessible from the homepage where customers can submit details about books they want to sell to Kitabi Keeda for resale
Create a menu section in the top-left corner of the navigation with dropdown or sidebar options including Settings, Personalization, and other utility menu items
Add a camera/lens icon button that allows customers to upload or capture images of books they want to search for or sell, enabling image-based book identification
Implement voice search functionality with a microphone icon that allows users to search for books using voice input
Update the business address throughout the website to reflect Kolkata, India as the location, particularly in the footer and contact sections
